## Scan Documents

## Docs

- [API Endpoints](https://scan-documents.com/docs/api-endpoints): Structure of the requests and responses for the API
- [Authentication](https://scan-documents.com/docs/authentication): Learn how to authenticate your requests
- [Errors](https://scan-documents.com/docs/errors): Errors returned by Scan Documents API
- [Welcome](https://scan-documents.com/docs): Welcome to Scan Documents API Documentation
- [Pagination](https://scan-documents.com/docs/pagination): Learn how to paginate through the results of the API
- [Webhooks](https://scan-documents.com/docs/webhooks): Learn how to receive events in your webhook endpoint
- [AI Agents](https://scan-documents.com/docs/ai-toolkit/agents): Enable your AI agents to manage documents operations with Scan Documents API.
- [Context7](https://scan-documents.com/docs/ai-toolkit/context7): Intelligent development with AI-augmented context
- [Introduction](https://scan-documents.com/docs/ai-toolkit): Integrate AI with Scan Documents API
- [llms.txt](https://scan-documents.com/docs/ai-toolkit/llm): Make docs content easier for LLMs to read and index
- [No Subscription](https://scan-documents.com/docs/errors/no-subscription): 409 - User does not have an active subscription
- [Not Found](https://scan-documents.com/docs/errors/not-found): 404 - The requested resource was not found
- [Unauthorized](https://scan-documents.com/docs/errors/unauthorized): 401 - You are not authorized to access this resource
- [Unsupported File Type](https://scan-documents.com/docs/errors/unsupported-file-type): 415 - The file type is not supported for this operation
- [Validation Error](https://scan-documents.com/docs/errors/validation-error): 422 - Request parameters failed validation
- [Automated Expense Reporting](https://scan-documents.com/docs/guides/automated-expense-reporting): Learn how to automate expense reporting by extracting structured data from receipts.
- [Convert Images to PDF](https://scan-documents.com/docs/guides/convert-images-to-pdf): Learn how to convert multiple images into a single PDF file.
- [Digitize Document for Archiving](https://scan-documents.com/docs/guides/digitize-document): Learn how to digitize a physical document for digital archiving and search.
- [Extract and Search Document Content](https://scan-documents.com/docs/guides/extract-text-from-document): Learn how to extract text from a document and make it searchable.
- [Introduction](https://scan-documents.com/docs/guides): Scan Documents API Guides
- [Invoice Processing](https://scan-documents.com/docs/guides/invoice-processing): Automate invoice processing by extracting structured data from PDF documents.
- [Merge PDFs](https://scan-documents.com/docs/guides/merge-pdfs): Learn how to merge multiple PDF files into a single document.
- [Quickstart](https://scan-documents.com/docs/guides/quickstart): Quickstart guide for using the API
- [Split a PDF](https://scan-documents.com/docs/guides/split-pdf): Learn how to split a large PDF into smaller, individual files.
- [Introduction](https://scan-documents.com/docs/integrations): Integrate No-Code tools with Scan Documents
- [Events](https://scan-documents.com/docs/events): Learn about the events in the API.
- [Files](https://scan-documents.com/docs/files): Learn about how Scan Documents handles file objects
- [Task Operations](https://scan-documents.com/docs/tasks): Learn about the task operations in the API.
- [OpenAPI Spec](https://scan-documents.com/docs/explore/openapi-spec): Reference the OpenAPI spec for the API
- [Playground](https://scan-documents.com/docs/explore/playground): Testing the API With the Playground
- [Postman Collection](https://scan-documents.com/docs/explore/postman): Test the API with Postman
- [Authentication](https://scan-documents.com/docs/integrations/zapier/authentication): Learn how to authenticate your requests
- [Introduction](https://scan-documents.com/docs/integrations/zapier): Integrate Zapier with Scan Documents
- [file.created](https://scan-documents.com/docs/file-events/file.created): This event is triggered when a file is created in the system.
- [file.deleted](https://scan-documents.com/docs/file-events/file.deleted): This event is triggered when a file is deleted from the system.
- [task.completed](https://scan-documents.com/docs/tasks-events/task.completed): This event is triggered when a task is completed in the system.
- [task.created](https://scan-documents.com/docs/tasks-events/task.created): This event is triggered when a task is created in the system.
- [task.deleted](https://scan-documents.com/docs/tasks-events/task.deleted): This event is triggered when a task is deleted in the system.
- [task.failed](https://scan-documents.com/docs/tasks-events/task.failed): This event is triggered when a task is failed in the system.
- [List events](https://scan-documents.com/docs/v1/events): Retrieves a paginated list of events belonging to the authenticated user.
- [Get files paginated](https://scan-documents.com/docs/v1/files/get): Gets the files of the user paginated
- [Upload a file](https://scan-documents.com/docs/v1/files/post): Creates a new file
- [Apply an effect to an image](https://scan-documents.com/docs/v1/image-operations/apply-effect): Creates a task to apply a specified visual effect to an image.
- [Convert image format](https://scan-documents.com/docs/v1/image-operations/convert): Creates a task to convert an image file to a different format.
- [Detect documents in an image](https://scan-documents.com/docs/v1/image-operations/detect-documents): Creates a task to detect document boundaries within an image.
- [Extract text from an image](https://scan-documents.com/docs/v1/image-operations/extract-text): Creates a task to extract text from a specified image file.
- [Scan an image](https://scan-documents.com/docs/v1/image-operations/scan-image): Creates a task to scan an image file. 
This is an equivalent operation for `detect-documents` and `warp` combined, additionally it can apply effects to the scanned image.
- [Warp (perspective correct) an image](https://scan-documents.com/docs/v1/image-operations/warp): Creates a task to apply perspective correction (warp) to an image based on detected document boundaries.
- [Extract pages from a PDF file](https://scan-documents.com/docs/v1/pdf-operations/extract-pages): Creates a task to extract specific pages from a PDF file into a new PDF file.
- [Merge files into PDF](https://scan-documents.com/docs/v1/pdf-operations/merge): Creates a task to merge multiple PDF and/or image files into a single PDF file.
- [Render PDF pages as images](https://scan-documents.com/docs/v1/pdf-operations/render): Creates a task to render specified pages of a PDF file as images.
- [Split a PDF file](https://scan-documents.com/docs/v1/pdf-operations/split): Creates a task to split a PDF file into multiple single-page PDF files.
- [List tasks](https://scan-documents.com/docs/v1/tasks/get): Retrieves a paginated list of tasks belonging to the authenticated user.
- [Delete a file](https://scan-documents.com/docs/v1/files/id/delete): Delete a file by id
- [Download a file](https://scan-documents.com/docs/v1/files/id/download): Download a file by id
- [Get a single file by id](https://scan-documents.com/docs/v1/files/id/get): Get a single file by id
- [Get Task](https://scan-documents.com/docs/v1/tasks/id/get): Retrieves the data for a specific task by its ID.
